Crossbody Shadow Clash.name: Crossbody Shadow Clash
Crossbody Shadow Clash.description: The user's signature move: the user and creature rush one target from opposite sides within a few strides. The creature strikes for heavy bludgeoning damage while the user drives the target to the ground; held back, the paired blows pin without a wound. Afterward the creature recoils and cannot emerge again until the end of the user's next turn. Strain: severe.
